view: orthographic-looking top-down view of a 4-way street intersection; image up (-y) = direction of travel

camera.evidence: static props identical (diff<~3 grey levels) between frames 0 and 71; no pan/shake

pixel_conventions: x right, y down, origin top-left pixel of the 2160x1080 frame

van.description: white van / minivan (dark-red windscreen at its top end = front), driving up the vertical road, left lane x~833
van.reference_point: mask centroid (top-down => approx. vehicle root/centre in plane)
van.motion: starts essentially at rest at frame 0 and speeds up steadily straight up (-y); x constant 833+-1
van.note_for_check_only: quadratic fit y(i)=924.5-0.28 i-0.139 i^2 px, rms 0.53 px (uniform acceleration)

cyclist.description: person riding a bicycle (seen from above), to the right of the van at x~917, moving up
cyclist.reference_point: mask centroid of bike+rider (approx. rider pelvis / bike root)
cyclist.motion: constant velocity straight up from frame 1 (frames 0 and 1 identical); ~8.9 px/frame
cyclist.note_for_check_only: linear fit y(i)=836.7-8.88 i px, rms 1.1 px
